examples.en: The president gave an inspiring speech to the nation on national day.
examples.zh: 總統在國慶日向全國發表了一場鼓舞人心的演講。

examples.en: She was appointed as the new president of the international company.
examples.zh: 她被任命為這間跨國公司的新任總裁。

examples.en: The club president invited all members to attend the annual meeting.
examples.zh: 社團主席邀請所有成員參加年度會議。

examples.en: Please read the following instructions carefully before starting the test.
examples.zh: 開始測驗前請仔細閱讀下述說明。

examples.en: We decided to leave the city on the following morning.
examples.zh: 我們決定隔天早上離開這座城市。

examples.en: The following table shows the monthly sales performance of our team.
examples.zh: 下表顯示了我們團隊的每月銷售績效。

examples.en: Following the lecture, students asked several interesting questions.
examples.zh: 在講座之後，學生們提出了幾個有趣的問題。

examples.en: He returned to work following a short vacation in Japan.
examples.zh: 在日本度過短暫假期後，他回到了工作崗位。

examples.en: The air became fresh and cool following the rainstorm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨之後，空氣變得清新涼爽。

examples.en: The popular writer has a large following among young readers.
examples.zh: 這位熱門作家在年輕讀者中有一大群追隨者。

examples.en: The rock band gained a strong following after their first concert.
examples.zh: 這支搖滾樂團在第一場演唱會後獲得了大批支持者。

examples.en: Her food blog has built up a loyal following over the years.
examples.zh: 這些年來，她的美食部落格建立了忠實的追隨者群體。

examples.en: The tall giraffe stretched its long neck to eat tree leaves.
examples.zh: 高大的長頸鹿伸長脖子吃樹葉。

examples.en: Children were excited to see a baby giraffe at the zoo.
examples.zh: 孩子們在動物園看到小長頸鹿感到非常興奮。

examples.en: A giraffe can sleep while standing up in the wild grassland.
examples.zh: 長頸鹿可以在野生草原上一邊站立一邊睡覺。

examples.en: The clever student found a simple way to solve the math puzzle.
examples.zh: 這個聰明的學生找到了一個簡單的方法來解決數學難題。

examples.en: He came up with a clever idea for the school science project.
examples.zh: 他為學校的科學專題想出了一個聰明的主意。

examples.en: It was clever of her to bring an extra umbrella.
examples.zh: 她多帶一把備用雨傘真是聰明。

examples.en: The experienced sailor guided the ship through the stormy sea.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的水手引導船隻穿過暴風雨的海洋。

examples.en: Sailors often spend several months at sea, far from home.
examples.zh: 水手們經常在海上一待就是好幾個月，遠離家鄉。

examples.en: My uncle worked as a sailor when he was young.
examples.zh: 我叔叔年輕時曾擔任水手。

examples.en: You can renew your gym membership online with a credit card.
examples.zh: 你可以使用信用卡線上續約你的健身房會員資格。

examples.en: The club membership has grown steadily over the past three years.
examples.zh: 在過去三年中，該社團的會員人數穩定成長。

examples.en: Show your membership card at the entrance to get a discount.
examples.zh: 在入口處出示你的會員卡以獲得折扣。

examples.en: Please present your ID card to prove your identity at check-in.
examples.zh: 辦理報到時請出示你的身分證件以證明身分。

examples.en: Traditional festivals help people keep their cultural identity.
examples.zh: 傳統節慶幫助人們保有自己的文化認同。

examples.en: He wants to protect his personal identity on social media networks.
examples.zh: 他想在社群網路平台上保護自己的個人身分。

examples.en: Living alone in a foreign country taught her great financial independence.
examples.zh: 獨自居住在國外教會了她極大的財務獨立。

examples.en: The country celebrated fifty years of national independence with fireworks.
examples.zh: 該國放煙火慶祝國家獨立五十週年。

examples.en: Encouraging children's independence helps them build strong confidence early.
examples.zh: 鼓勵孩子的自主性有助於他們早期建立強大的自信。

examples.en: The library is located within walking distance of our school.
examples.zh: 圖書館位於我們學校步行距離之內。

examples.en: Please complete the registration form within five business days.
examples.zh: 請在五個工作天之內填妥報名表。

examples.en: Please keep this information within the team.
examples.zh: 請將這項資訊保留在團隊內部。

senses.zh: 大腿（坐姿時）；（跑道的）一圈

examples.en: The cute kitten fell asleep comfortably on her warm lap.
examples.zh: 可愛的小貓咪在她溫暖的大腿上舒服地睡著了。

examples.en: The runner completed the final lap and won the race.
examples.zh: 這名跑者完成了最後一圈並贏得了比賽。

examples.en: She placed her napkin gently on her lap before eating.
examples.zh: 她在用餐前將餐巾溫柔地放在大腿上。

examples.en: Soft ocean waves lapped gently against the sandy beach.
examples.zh: 柔和的海浪輕拍著沙灘。

examples.en: The fast swimmer lapped other competitors in the pool.
examples.zh: 這名快速的游泳選手在泳池裡領先其他競爭對手一圈。

examples.en: The dog lapped up the milk from the bowl quickly.
examples.zh: 小狗很快把碗裡的牛奶舔光了。

examples.en: This report provides a clear instance of effective communication skills.
examples.zh: 這份報告提供了一個有效溝通技巧的清晰實例。

examples.en: In most instances, customer complaints are handled within one day.
examples.zh: 在大多數情況下，顧客的抱怨會在一天內處理完畢。

examples.en: Let me give you an instance to explain my point.
examples.zh: 讓我給你舉一個例子來解釋我的觀點。

examples.en: The sudden loud thunder scared the little girl in bed.
examples.zh: 突如其來的巨響雷聲嚇到了床上的小女孩。

examples.en: Horror movies always scare my younger brother at night.
examples.zh: 恐怖電影總是在晚上嚇到我的弟弟。

examples.en: Do not scare the birds away while taking pictures.
examples.zh: 拍照時不要把鳥兒嚇跑了。

examples.en: The false alarm created a huge scare among office workers.
examples.zh: 虛驚一場的警報在上班族之間引起了巨大的恐慌。

examples.en: She had a health scare last year but fully recovered.
examples.zh: 她去年曾因健康問題虛驚一場，但後來完全康復了。

examples.en: The sudden noise gave everyone in the room a real scare.
examples.zh: 突如其來的噪音讓房間裡的每個人都嚇了一跳。

examples.en: Choose a partner to complete the English speaking exercise together.
examples.zh: 選擇一位搭檔一起完成英語口說練習。

examples.en: He met his business partner during his time at university.
examples.zh: 他在大學時期結識了他的商業夥伴。

examples.en: She danced gracefully across the hall with her dance partner.
examples.zh: 她與她的舞蹈搭檔優雅地翩翩起舞穿過大廳。

examples.en: I love eating fruit in summer, especially fresh watermelon.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在夏天吃水果，尤其是新鮮的西瓜。

examples.en: This coat was designed especially for extremely cold winter days.
examples.zh: 這件大衣是特別為極度寒冷的冬日所設計的。

examples.en: She was especially happy because she passed her driving test.
examples.zh: 她特別高興，因為她通過了駕照考試。

examples.en: The generous manager bought lunch for the entire office staff.
examples.zh: 那位大方的經理為全辦公室員工買了午餐。

examples.en: He made a generous donation to help the local animal shelter.
examples.zh: 他做出慷慨的捐款來幫助當地的動物收容所。

examples.en: Thank you for your generous hospitality during our stay here.
examples.zh: 感謝在我們停留期間你們慷慨的款待。

examples.en: The talented musician played the violin beautifully on stage.
examples.zh: 這位有天份的音樂家在舞台上精彩地演奏小提琴。

examples.en: Several professional musicians joined the symphony orchestra this year.
examples.zh: 幾位專業樂手今年加入了交響樂團。

examples.en: She hopes to become a famous street musician in the future.
examples.zh: 她希望未來能成為一位著名的街頭音樂家。

examples.en: The carpenter used a sharp electric saw to cut wood.
examples.zh: 木匠使用銳利的電鋸來切割木頭。

examples.en: Always keep your hands away from the saw blade.
examples.zh: 請務必讓雙手遠離鋸片。

examples.en: He bought a hand saw from the local hardware store.
examples.zh: 他從當地的五金行買了一把手鋸。

examples.en: He sawed the thick branch into small logs for firewood.
examples.zh: 他把粗樹枝鋸成小木塊當作柴火。

examples.en: Workers sawed through the heavy wooden door during home repair.
examples.zh: 工人在房屋維修期間鋸開了沉重的木門。

examples.en: She sawed off the extra piece of board carefully.
examples.zh: 她小心地鋸掉多餘的木板。

examples.en: Everyone wore a face mask on the crowded subway train.
examples.zh: 每個人在擁擠的捷運列車上都戴著口罩。

examples.en: Children wore colorful superhero masks to the Halloween party.
examples.zh: 孩子們戴著五彩繽紛的超級英雄面具去參加萬聖節派對。

examples.en: The doctor put on a surgical mask before the operation.
examples.zh: 醫生在手術前戴上了醫用口罩。

examples.en: The strong smell of spices masked the taste of fish.
examples.zh: 濃烈的香料氣味掩飾了魚的味道。

examples.en: She tried to mask her disappointment with a sweet smile.
examples.zh: 她試圖用甜美的微笑來掩飾自己的失望。

examples.en: The thick fog masked the tall buildings across the river.
examples.zh: 濃霧遮蔽了河對岸的高樓。

examples.en: The airline operates both domestic and international passenger flights.
examples.zh: 這間航空公司營運國內與國際客運航班。

examples.en: She shared the burden of domestic chores with her husband.
examples.zh: 她與丈夫分擔家務負擔。

examples.en: Cats and dogs are common domestic pets in many families.
examples.zh: 貓和狗是許多家庭中常見的家養寵物。

examples.en: Earthquakes often occur in this coastal region during springtime.
examples.zh: 這座沿海地區在春季經常發生地震。

examples.en: A brilliant idea occurred to him while taking a walk.
examples.zh: 散步時他突然想到了一個絕妙的主意。

examples.en: Accidents can occur when drivers fail to follow traffic rules.
examples.zh: 當駕駛未遵守交通規則時，事故就可能發生。

examples.en: Students were asked to write a short essay about nature.
examples.zh: 學生們被要求寫一篇關於自然的短文。

examples.en: Her English essay won first prize in the national competition.
examples.zh: 她的英文文章在全國比賽中獲得頭獎。

examples.en: Please hand in your history essay before Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 請在週五下午前交出你的歷史短文。

examples.en: He tried to control his anger during the heated discussion.
examples.zh: 他在激烈的討論中試圖控制自己的憤怒。

examples.en: Her face turned red with anger when she heard the news.
examples.zh: 當她聽到消息時，她的臉因怒氣而發紅。

examples.en: Expressing anger constructively is an important social skill.
examples.zh: 建設性地表達憤怒是一項重要的社交技能。

examples.en: His rude remarks angered many colleagues at the office.
examples.zh: 他無禮的話語激怒了辦公室的許多同事。

examples.en: Repeated delays angered the waiting passengers at the airport terminal.
examples.zh: 接二連三的延誤激怒了機場航廈等待的旅客。

examples.en: Do not anger your parents by breaking household rules.
examples.zh: 不要打破家規來激怒你的父母。

examples.en: The little rabbit hopped across the green lawn happily.
examples.zh: 小兔子開心地蹦蹦跳跳穿過綠色草坪。

examples.en: He hopped on one foot because his shoe came off.
examples.zh: 因為鞋子脫落了，他用單腳跳著。

examples.en: A small bird hopped onto the wooden bench beside me.
examples.zh: 一隻小鳥跳上了我身旁的木製長椅。

examples.en: It is only a short hop by plane between the two cities.
examples.zh: 這兩座城市之間搭飛機只是短短一趟飛行。

examples.en: The boy took a hop over the mud puddle.
examples.zh: 男孩一躍跳過了那灘泥水。

examples.en: We decided to take a quick hop over to Taiwan.
examples.zh: 我們決定搭短程飛機去台灣一趟。

examples.en: A mass of dark clouds gathered quickly in the afternoon sky.
examples.zh: 午後的天空迅速聚集了一大片烏雲。

examples.en: Scientists calculated the total mass of the faraway planet.
examples.zh: 科學家計算出了這顆遙遠行星的總質量。

examples.en: The museum attracted a mass of visitors on opening day.
examples.zh: 這間博物館在開幕當天吸引了大批參觀者。

examples.en: Buses and trains are an eco-friendly form of mass transportation here.
examples.zh: 公車和火車在這裡是一種環保的大眾運輸方式。

examples.en: Mass production helped lower the cost of electronic goods.
examples.zh: 大規模生產有助於降低電子商品的成本。

examples.en: The event received broad coverage in mass media nationwide.
examples.zh: 這項活動獲得了全國大眾媒體的廣泛報導。

examples.en: The judge entered the court and sat down quietly.
examples.zh: 法官進入法庭並安靜地坐下。

examples.en: We booked a basketball court for our school tournament.
examples.zh: 我們為學校錦標賽預訂了一座籃球場。

examples.en: Ancient kings welcomed foreign guests to their lavish court.
examples.zh: 古代國王在他們的奢華宮廷接待外國賓客。

examples.en: The little bird escaped from the open cage yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 小鳥昨天早上從打開的籠子裡逃跑了。

examples.en: They managed to escape the burning building without any injury.
examples.zh: 他們設法逃離了火災建築物且沒有受傷。

examples.en: We went to the beach to escape the summer heat.
examples.zh: 我們去海灘躲避夏日的酷熱。

examples.en: Reading fantasy books offers a pleasant escape from daily stress.
examples.zh: 閱讀奇幻書籍提供了遠離日常壓力的一種愉快逃避。

examples.en: The clever thief made a narrow escape from police officers.
examples.zh: 這個聰明的竊賊險些從警察手中逃脫。

examples.en: The cat made a quick escape through the open window.
examples.zh: 貓咪從敞開的窗戶迅速逃走了。

examples.en: She used art to express her deep feelings and emotions.
examples.zh: 她用藝術來表達她深層的感受與情緒。

examples.en: Please express your opinion clearly during the team meeting.
examples.zh: 請在團隊會議期間清晰表達你的意見。

examples.en: He sent a card to express his gratitude to the teacher.
examples.zh: 他寄了一張卡片向老師表示感謝。

examples.en: We took the express to Kaohsiung and arrived in just ninety minutes.
examples.zh: 我們搭乘快車前往高雄，只花了九十分鐘就到了。

examples.en: The package was sent by express and arrived the next day.
examples.zh: 包裹以快遞寄出，隔天就到了。

examples.en: The airport express reaches the downtown terminal in twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 機場快線二十分鐘內可到達市中心終點站。

examples.en: This package was delivered using our fastest express service.
examples.zh: 這包包裹是使用我們最快速的快遞服務送達的。

examples.en: Passengers can use the express lane to clear security fast.
examples.zh: 旅客可以使用快速通道快速通過安檢。

examples.en: The policy was created with the express purpose of helping students.
examples.zh: 該政策建立的明確目的就是為了幫助學生。

examples.en: She drank a hot mug of cocoa on a winter evening.
examples.zh: 她在冬日夜晚喝了一馬克杯熱可可。

examples.en: Add two tablespoons of cocoa powder to the cake batter.
examples.zh: 在蛋糕麵糊中加入兩大匙可可粉。

examples.en: Hot cocoa with marshmallows is my favorite sweet drink.
examples.zh: 加了棉花糖的熱可可是我最喜歡的甜飲料。

examples.en: It is necessary to wear a seatbelt while driving.
examples.zh: 開車時繫上安全帶是必要的。

examples.en: Water and sunlight are necessary elements for plant growth.
examples.zh: 水與陽光是植物生長的必需元素。

examples.en: Take all necessary steps to protect your personal data online.
examples.zh: 採取一切必要的步驟在網路上保護你的個人資料。

examples.en: The company decided to reject his proposal after careful review.
examples.zh: 經過仔細審查後，公司決定拒絕他的提案。

examples.en: She was sad when the university rejected her application.
examples.zh: 當大學不錄取她的申請時，她很難過。

examples.en: The machine will reject damaged coins automatically during counting.
examples.zh: 機器在清點過程中會自動拒絕受損的硬幣。

examples.en: You can call me anytime if you need urgent help.
examples.zh: 如果你需要急迫幫助，你可以在任何時候打給我。

examples.en: Feel free to visit our office anytime during business hours.
examples.zh: 營業時間內歡迎隨時蒞臨我們的辦公室。

examples.en: Guests can use the hotel swimming pool anytime between 6 a.m. and 10 p.m.
examples.zh: 住客可在早上六點到晚上十點之間隨時使用飯店游泳池。

examples.en: He put his heavy textbooks inside his school backpack.
examples.zh: 他把沉重的課本放進他的學校後背包裡。

examples.en: She bought a waterproof backpack for her hiking trip.
examples.zh: 她為她的健行之旅買了一個防水後背包。

examples.en: My red backpack was left under the classroom desk.
examples.zh: 我的紅色後背包被遺留在教室課桌下。

examples.en: They plan to backpack across Europe during summer vacation.
examples.zh: 他們計畫在暑假期間去歐洲背包旅行。

examples.en: She spent three months backpacking through Southeast Asian countries.
examples.zh: 她花了三個月的時間在東南亞國家背包旅行。

examples.en: We love to backpack in national parks every autumn.
examples.zh: 我們喜歡每年秋天去國家公園背包旅行。

examples.en: My classmate was ill yesterday and stayed home resting.
examples.zh: 我同學昨天生病了，待在家裡休息。

examples.en: Smoking can have serious ill effects on human lungs.
examples.zh: 吸菸可能對人體肺部造成嚴重的不良影響。

examples.en: She nursed her ill grandfather with great care every day.
examples.zh: 她每天都細心照料她生病的祖父。

examples.en: My mother bought a fresh head of cabbage at the market.
examples.zh: 我媽媽在市場買了一顆新鮮的高麗菜。

examples.en: We cooked stir-fried cabbage with garlic for dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐煮了蒜炒高麗菜。

examples.en: Cabbage is a common vegetable in Taiwanese home cooking.
examples.zh: 高麗菜是台灣家庭料理中常見的蔬菜。

examples.en: This brand is famous for producing durable sports shoes.
examples.zh: 這個品牌以生產耐用運動鞋而聞名。

examples.en: They launched a new brand of organic fruit juice.
examples.zh: 他們推出了一個新的有機果汁品牌。

examples.en: Consumers trust this coffee brand for its high quality.
examples.zh: 消費者因為高品質而信任這個咖啡品牌。

senses.zh: 不同意；意見不合；（食物）不適合

examples.en: I respect your opinion, but I disagree with you.
examples.zh: 我尊重你的意見，但我不同意你的看法。

examples.en: Members disagreed on how to spend the club budget.
examples.zh: 成員們對於如何使用社團預算持異議。

examples.en: Certain seafood always disagrees with my sensitive stomach.
examples.zh: 某些海鮮總是與我敏感的胃不合。

examples.en: None of the students missed the important morning lecture.
examples.zh: 沒有一個學生錯過這堂重要的早晨講座。

examples.en: We searched for the keys, but found none in the room.
examples.zh: 我們尋找鑰匙，但在房間裡毫無所獲。

examples.en: I wanted some cake, but there was none left.
examples.zh: 我想吃點蛋糕，但一塊也不剩了。

examples.en: There is a high possibility of rain this evening.
examples.zh: 今晚有很大的下雨可能性。

examples.en: We are exploring every possibility to improve our product.
examples.zh: 我們正在探索改善我們產品的每一種可能性。

examples.en: Scientists are studying the possibility of life on other planets.
examples.zh: 科學家正在研究其他星球存在生命的可能性。

examples.en: Could you please turn down the music a bit?
examples.zh: 你可以把音樂音量關小一點點嗎？

examples.en: He saved a small bit of cake for his sister.
examples.zh: 他留了一小塊蛋糕給他妹妹。

examples.en: She was a bit tired after the long walk home.
examples.zh: 在長途走回家後，她有一點點累。

examples.en: The principal delivered an inspiring speech at the graduation ceremony.
examples.zh: 校長在畢業典禮上發表了一場鼓舞人心的演講。

examples.en: Her clear speech made it easy for everyone to understand.
examples.zh: 她清晰的言語讓每個人都很容易理解。

examples.en: He gave a humorous speech that made the audience laugh loudly.
examples.zh: 他發表了一場幽默的演說，讓觀眾大聲發笑。

examples.en: That item costs fifty dollars altogether with tax included.
examples.zh: 包含稅金在內，那個品項總共花費五十美元。

examples.en: The heavy rain stopped altogether by late afternoon.
examples.zh: 到了傍晚，大雨完全停了。

examples.en: Altogether, the school trip was an unforgettable experience for everyone.
examples.zh: 整體而言，這趟校外教學對每個人來說都是難忘的體驗。

examples.en: The police are investigating the primary cause of the accident.
examples.zh: 警方正在調查事故的主要原因。

examples.en: Heavy traffic was the main cause of his late arrival.
examples.zh: 嚴重塞車是他遲到的主要原因。

examples.en: They raised funds for a noble cause to help orphans.
examples.zh: 他們為幫助孤兒的高尚事業籌集資金。

examples.en: Strong winds caused severe damage to the wooden roof.
examples.zh: 強風對木製屋頂造成了嚴重損害。

examples.en: Eating too fast can cause uncomfortable stomach pain.
examples.zh: 吃太快可能會導致不舒服的胃痛。

examples.en: His careless mistake caused a long delay for the project.
examples.zh: 他的粗心錯誤導致專案大幅延誤。

examples.en: It was a cool cloudy morning in early autumn.
examples.zh: 那是初秋一個涼爽的多雲早晨。

examples.en: The weather turns cloudy, so we might need umbrellas.
examples.zh: 天氣轉為陰天，所以我們可能需要雨傘。

examples.en: We could not see stars clearly through the cloudy sky.
examples.zh: 我們無法透過多雲的天空清晰看見星星。

examples.en: Music can evoke strong emotions of joy and sadness.
examples.zh: 音樂能引發喜悅與悲傷的強烈情緒。

examples.en: Her voice shook with emotion as she received the award.
examples.zh: 她領獎時，聲音因激動而顫抖。

examples.en: It is healthy to express your emotions freely at home.
examples.zh: 在家裡自由表達自己的情感是健康的。

examples.en: Please wash your hands carefully with soap before meals.
examples.zh: 用餐前請務必用肥皂仔細洗手。

examples.en: He washed his dirty bicycle in the garden yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天在花園裡清洗了他的髒腳踏車。

examples.en: She washes her clothes at the laundry every weekend.
examples.zh: 她每個週末都會在洗衣店洗衣服。

examples.en: Give the fresh vegetables a thorough wash before cooking.
examples.zh: 烹飪前將新鮮蔬菜徹底清洗一次。

examples.en: The car needs a good wash after the long road trip.
examples.zh: 經過長途公路旅行後，這輛車需要好好洗一洗。

examples.en: She put the dirty sheets in the wash after breakfast.
examples.zh: 她吃完早餐後，把髒床單放進待洗衣物裡。

examples.en: Children love to slide down the snowy hill on sleds.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡坐雪橇從積雪的山丘上滑下來。

examples.en: The glass plate slid off the wet counter top.
examples.zh: 玻璃盤子從濕滑的檯面上滑落。

examples.en: Prices slid by twenty percent during the seasonal sale.
examples.zh: 在季節促銷期間，價格下滑了百分之二十。

examples.en: Kids queued up eagerly for the playground slide.
examples.zh: 孩子們熱切地排隊玩遊樂場滑梯。

examples.en: The speaker showed a helpful slide to illustrate data.
examples.zh: 講者展示了一張有用的幻燈片來說明數據。

examples.en: The water park has a long slide that ends in a big pool.
examples.zh: 水上樂園有一座通往大泳池的長滑梯。

examples.en: They enjoy eating Western food such as pasta and pizza.
examples.zh: 他們喜歡吃義大利麵與披薩等西方美食。

examples.en: The western region of the island is famous for beaches.
examples.zh: 該島嶼的西部地區以海灘聞名。

examples.en: He studies Western art history at university this semester.
examples.zh: 這學期他在大學修習西方藝術史。

examples.en: Both parties signed a formal contract for the project.
examples.zh: 雙方為該專案簽署了正式合約。

examples.en: Please read all terms in the contract before agreeing.
examples.zh: 同意前請閱讀合約中的所有條款。

examples.en: The employment contract is valid for two full years.
examples.zh: 這份僱用契約的效期為整整兩年。

examples.en: Metals expand when heated and contract when cooled down.
examples.zh: 金屬受熱時膨脹，冷卻時收縮。

examples.en: The company contracted a local firm to build offices.
examples.zh: 該公司與當地公司簽約來興建辦公室。

examples.en: Muscles contract automatically when you perform heavy lifting.
examples.zh: 當你進行重物提舉時，肌肉會自動收縮。

examples.en: Her face looked pale after hearing the bad news.
examples.zh: 聽到壞消息後，她的臉色看起來很蒼白。

examples.en: She wore a pale yellow dress to a summer party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件淺黃色的洋裝去參加夏天派對。

examples.en: The morning sun gave off a pale light in winter.
examples.zh: 冬日的朝陽發出淺淡的光芒。

examples.en: This bridge is built with strong steel and iron.
examples.zh: 這座橋樑是用堅固的鋼和鐵建造的。

examples.en: She bought a modern steam iron to smooth clothes.
examples.zh: 她買了一個現代蒸氣熨斗來熨平衣服。

examples.en: Iron is an essential mineral for healthy human blood.
examples.zh: 鐵是人體健康血液必需的礦物質。

examples.en: He ironed his white shirt for a job interview this morning.
examples.zh: 他為了今天早上的求職面試熨燙了他的白襯衫。

examples.en: My mother irons all school uniforms on Sunday evening.
examples.zh: 我媽媽在週日晚上熨燙所有的學校制服。

examples.en: Please iron out the wrinkles on the tablecloth.
examples.zh: 請熨平桌布上的皺褶。
